embeds.title: 🕯️ Dates are a scene now
embeds.description: Take your crush, partner or spouse out and actually be on the date. Every action raises (or dents) the spark. Romantic dates only.

embeds.title: 🍝 Every venue is different
embeds.description: Restaurant (wine, footsie, shared dessert), movies (popcorn, an arm around the shoulder), gala (slow dance, champagne, the balcony), concert, park, arcade, beach, picnic, mini-golf, or cooking dinner at home.

embeds.title: 💋 Moments
embeds.description: As the spark rises: hold hands, kiss, French kiss — then back to your place, or sneaking off to the restroom if they're really in love. Sometimes they suggest it. Condom or not is your call. Adults with Mature Content on, and not too drunk.

embeds.title: 🏠 Your place
embeds.description: Invite them over from their profile, or text a partner "Come over?" — it's a date at your place: the tour, cooking, takeout, a couch movie, cuddling, board games. End it with a calm night in, or the bedroom (condom or not). The nicer your home, the better it goes: a shared flat is a small minus, a mansion a big plus. Intimacy now brings you much closer.

embeds.title: ⏰ Tonight means tonight
embeds.description: "Movie tonight?" "Come over?" — say yes in the evening or at night and it starts right away. Say yes in the morning and it's this evening, same day. No more plans sliding into next month.

embeds.title: 💶 Euros & fixes
embeds.description: Lives under EU laws now show every price in euros (1 € = 1.12 $). Also fixed: the creator's start button said "Start at age 14" even when you picked 23.
